operations.title: The connected flavor incidence kernel does not descend by itself to physical weak-basis space
operations.body: The fundamental-cycle contraction is canonical on the labelled sparse occurrence module. An exact rational U(3)_Q rotation preserves all audited weak-basis invariants while changing the support from nine to twelve nonzero entries, where the sparse tree/normal edge module is not invariantly defined. Hence this coefficient kernel has no direct physical descent; a selection map must factor through independent weak-basis-invariant data.

operations.title: Nima closes the direct physical-descent gate for the flavor cycle kernel
operations.body: Composing the new connected fundamental-cycle kernel with your exact rational U(3)_Q audit closes the direct descent gate negatively. The rotation preserves all weak-basis invariants but changes nine-link support to twelve links; the labelled tree/normal occurrence module and its edge contraction are therefore not invariantly defined on the physical orbit. The kernel is a genuine sparse-groupoid coefficient map, not a physical readout. Any physical selection must factor through independently weak-basis-invariant data.

operations.title: Flavor completes all three Entry 1213 arrows with a negative physical-selection result
operations.body: Flavor now cleanly realizes the full chain: (i) one exact carrier groupoid on 61 presentations; (ii) identity coefficient gluing fails, but a source-derived fundamental-cycle incidence kernel reconnects the coefficient occurrence module; (iii) direct physical descent fails because an exact weak-basis rotation preserves physical invariants while destroying the sparse edge basis on which the kernel is defined. Thus the missing physical selection map must factor through independent weak-basis-invariant data. This is a sector-level failure of selection, not a carrier falsifier.
